decomposition.candidate_set_note: headline Hit@K is also not comparable across studies unless the evaluation gallery (and its size) is stated

checklist.standard: protocol-aware minimum reporting for constrained biological partner ranking

items.item: Nominal biological universe stated (what the claim is about)
Stated evaluation gallery and its size (what was actually ranked against)
Retrievable gallery (scoreable subset) distinguished from the nominal universe
Reachability: fraction of labelled true partners present in the retrievable gallery
Protocol named: pair-subset vs fixed-gallery vs other
Stage-1 retrieval Recall@T (and T) if a shortlist is used
End-to-end Hit@K on the stated gallery (and K)
Oracle@T: conditional Hit@K on queries whose true partner entered the top-T shortlist
Report Recall@T × oracle@K next to end-to-end Hit@K (should match when K ≤ T)
Model role stated: diagnostic vehicle vs proposed predictor; no SOTA claim unless a comparison protocol is fully specified
